doc:
The geometric record uses the same fixed slots and the current
finite label set.  The particular support adapter is supplied below.
name: NavierStokes.ActualCycleAssembly.assemblyOfParticularSupport

signature.text:
{B N0 : ℕ} →
  {σ κ : ℝ} →
    {P : NavierStokes.ActualCycleAssembly.Index B N0 → ℕ → NavierStokes.ActualCycleAssembly.Point → ℝ} →
      {carrier : NavierStokes.ActualCycleAssembly.Index B N0 → ℕ → Set NavierStokes.ActualCycleAssembly.Point} →
        (x : NavierStokes.CorrectionStep.CycleState (NavierStokes.ActualCycleAssembly.Index B N0)) →
          (H :
              NavierStokes.CorrectionStep.CycleAnalyticInvariant NavierStokes.ActualInitialization.geometry
                (NavierStokes.CorrectionInitialization.ActualPrimary.commonContext B)
                NavierStokes.ActualInitialization.tangentBlock P carrier σ x) →
            (hσ : 1 / 5 ≤ σ) →
              (hpart :
                  ∀ (i : Fin 3) (j : ℤ),
                    NavierStokes.LabelSumBounds.UniformWaveClass NavierStokes.ActualInitialization.geometry.strip P
                      (1 / 2 + σ)
                      fun (l : NavierStokes.ActualCycleAssembly.Index B N0) (n : ℕ)
                        (z : NavierStokes.SignedMeanGain.Point) =>
                      (((NavierStokes.ActualCycleParameters.fixedParameters B N0).particularBlock x.coefficients
                                (NavierStokes.CorrectionInitialization.ActualPrimary.commonContext B) x.state
                                l).velocity
                            n i).coeff
                        j z) →
                (htangent :
                    ∀ (i : Fin 3) (j : ℤ),
                      NavierStokes.LabelSumBounds.UniformWaveClass NavierStokes.ActualInitialization.geometry.strip P
                        (1 / 2 + σ - κ)
                        fun (l : NavierStokes.ActualCycleAssembly.Index B N0) (n : ℕ)
                          (z : NavierStokes.SignedMeanGain.Point) =>
                        (((NavierStokes.ActualCycleParameters.fixedParameters B N0).signedTangent x.coefficients
                                  (NavierStokes.CorrectionInitialization.ActualPrimary.commonContext B) x.state
                                  l).velocity
                              n i).coeff
                          j z) →
                  (hcurl :
                      ∀ (i : Fin 3) (j : ℤ),
                        NavierStokes.LabelSumBounds.UniformWaveClass NavierStokes.ActualInitialization.geometry.strip P
                          (1 + σ - 2 * κ)
                          fun (l : NavierStokes.ActualCycleAssembly.Index B N0) (n : ℕ)
                            (z : NavierStokes.SignedMeanGain.Point) =>
                          (((NavierStokes.ActualCycleParameters.fixedParameters B N0).signedCurl x.coefficients
                                    (NavierStokes.CorrectionInitialization.ActualPrimary.commonContext B) x.state
                                    l).velocity
                                n i).coeff
                            j z) →
                    (hP0 :
                        ∀ (l : NavierStokes.ActualCycleAssembly.Index B N0) (n : ℕ),
                          ∀ z ∈ NavierStokes.ActualInitialization.geometry.strip.domain, 0 ≤ P l n z) →
                      (hP1 :
                          ∀ (l : NavierStokes.ActualCycleAssembly.Index B N0) (n : ℕ),
                            ∀ z ∈ NavierStokes.ActualInitialization.geometry.strip.domain, P l n z ≤ 1) →
                        NavierStokes.ActualCarrierGeometry.geometricThreshold ≤ N0 →
                          (∀ (l : NavierStokes.ActualCycleAssembly.Index B N0) (n : ℕ),
                              carrier l n ⊆ NavierStokes.ActualInitialization.labelCarrier l n) →
                            (∀ (l : NavierStokes.ActualInitialization.Index B N0),
                                NavierStokes.HarmonicSourceSupport.InputSupportOn
                                  NavierStokes.ActualInitialization.geometry.domain
                                  (NavierStokes.ActualInitialization.labelCarrier l)
                                  ((NavierStokes.ActualCycleParameters.fixedParameters B N0).particularBlock
                                    x.coefficients (NavierStokes.CorrectionInitialization.ActualPrimary.commonContext B)
                                    x.state l)
                                  ((NavierStokes.ActualCycleParameters.fixedParameters B N0).particularGaussianBlock
                                      x.coefficients
                                      (NavierStokes.CorrectionInitialization.ActualPrimary.commonContext B) x.state
                                      l).velocity
                                  0) →
                              NavierStokes.SignedMeanGain.Assembly
                                (NavierStokes.ActualCycleAssembly.family x H hσ hpart htangent hcurl hP0 hP1)

value.text:
fun {B N0 : ℕ} {σ κ : ℝ}
    {P : NavierStokes.ActualCycleAssembly.Index B N0 → ℕ → NavierStokes.ActualCycleAssembly.Point → ℝ}
    {carrier : NavierStokes.ActualCycleAssembly.Index B N0 → ℕ → Set NavierStokes.ActualCycleAssembly.Point}
    (x : NavierStokes.CorrectionStep.CycleState (NavierStokes.ActualCycleAssembly.Index B N0))
    (H :
      NavierStokes.CorrectionStep.CycleAnalyticInvariant NavierStokes.ActualInitialization.geometry
        (NavierStokes.CorrectionInitialization.ActualPrimary.commonContext B)
        NavierStokes.ActualInitialization.tangentBlock P carrier σ x)
    (hσ : 1 / 5 ≤ σ)
    (hpart :
      ∀ (i : Fin 3) (j : ℤ),
        NavierStokes.LabelSumBounds.UniformWaveClass NavierStokes.ActualInitialization.geometry.strip P (1 / 2 + σ)
          fun (l : NavierStokes.ActualCycleAssembly.Index B N0) (n : ℕ) (z : NavierStokes.SignedMeanGain.Point) =>
          (((NavierStokes.ActualCycleParameters.fixedParameters B N0).particularBlock x.coefficients
                    (NavierStokes.CorrectionInitialization.ActualPrimary.commonContext B) x.state l).velocity
                n i).coeff
            j z)
    (htangent :
      ∀ (i : Fin 3) (j : ℤ),
        NavierStokes.LabelSumBounds.UniformWaveClass NavierStokes.ActualInitialization.geometry.strip P (1 / 2 + σ - κ)
          fun (l : NavierStokes.ActualCycleAssembly.Index B N0) (n : ℕ) (z : NavierStokes.SignedMeanGain.Point) =>
          (((NavierStokes.ActualCycleParameters.fixedParameters B N0).signedTangent x.coefficients
                    (NavierStokes.CorrectionInitialization.ActualPrimary.commonContext B) x.state l).velocity
                n i).coeff
            j z)
    (hcurl :
      ∀ (i : Fin 3) (j : ℤ),
        NavierStokes.LabelSumBounds.UniformWaveClass NavierStokes.ActualInitialization.geometry.strip P (1 + σ - 2 * κ)
          fun (l : NavierStokes.ActualCycleAssembly.Index B N0) (n : ℕ) (z : NavierStokes.SignedMeanGain.Point) =>
          (((NavierStokes.ActualCycleParameters.fixedParameters B N0).signedCurl x.coefficients
                    (NavierStokes.CorrectionInitialization.ActualPrimary.commonContext B) x.state l).velocity
                n i).coeff
            j z)
    (hP0 :
      ∀ (l : NavierStokes.ActualCycleAssembly.Index B N0) (n : ℕ),
        ∀ z ∈ NavierStokes.ActualInitialization.geometry.strip.domain, 0 ≤ P l n z)
    (hP1 :
      ∀ (l : NavierStokes.ActualCycleAssembly.Index B N0) (n : ℕ),
        ∀ z ∈ NavierStokes.ActualInitialization.geometry.strip.domain, P l n z ≤ 1)
    (hN : NavierStokes.ActualCarrierGeometry.geometricThreshold ≤ N0)
    (hcarrier :
      ∀ (l : NavierStokes.ActualCycleAssembly.Index B N0) (n : ℕ),
        carrier l n ⊆ NavierStokes.ActualInitialization.labelCarrier l n)
    (hpartSupport :
      ∀ (l : NavierStokes.ActualInitialization.Index B N0),
        NavierStokes.HarmonicSourceSupport.InputSupportOn NavierStokes.ActualInitialization.geometry.domain
          (NavierStokes.ActualInitialization.labelCarrier l)
          ((NavierStokes.ActualCycleParameters.fixedParameters B N0).particularBlock x.coefficients
            (NavierStokes.CorrectionInitialization.ActualPrimary.commonContext B) x.state l)
          ((NavierStokes.ActualCycleParameters.fixedParameters B N0).particularGaussianBlock x.coefficients
              (NavierStokes.CorrectionInitialization.ActualPrimary.commonContext B) x.state l).velocity
          0) =>
  { width := NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.D NavierStokes.CorrectionInitialization.ActualPrimary.h,
    exponent := NavierStokes.CorrectionInitialization.ActualPrimary.h,
    vr := NavierStokes.CorrectionInitialization.ActualPrimary.radialVector,
    vt := NavierStokes.CorrectionInitialization.ActualPrimary.temporalVector,
    slots := NavierStokes.CorrectionInitialization.ActualPrimary.slots, labels := x.coefficients.labels,
    label := NavierStokes.ActualCycleAssembly.label, injective := ⋯, level := ⋯,
    window := NavierStokes.ActualPrimaryCovariance.physicalWindow,
    window_continuous := NavierStokes.ActualPrimaryCovariance.physicalWindow_continuousOn,
    auxiliary := NavierStokes.ActualPrimaryCovariance.absoluteAuxiliary, primary_support := ⋯, old_support := ⋯,
    tangent_support := ⋯, curl_support := ⋯ }
